name: a7_cmp_noise/ccp300
description:
OBJECTIVE
    Ablation 7 - WHEN DOES A SHARING RULE BECOME UNSTABLE?  Sensitivity to the farmer-specific
    sequestration noise  CMP_ij = CMP_j * (1 + U(-cmp_noise, +cmp_noise))   (App. B.5; the paper does
    not describe this noise and the baseline uses 0.20).

    Why this knob: stability is lost when some sub-coalition T can do better than its share, i.e.
    vhat(T) > x(T).  Area-proportional pays every farmer per hectare and ignores carbon yield, so a
    farmer with a low CMP draw is over-paid; the remaining farmers can block by leaving without
    them (blockers.csv: the worst blocking coalitions are 12-14 of the 15 farmers, with a slightly
    higher mean CMP than the panel).  Noise widens that gap.  Shapley only breaks at high carbon prices.
    Budget noise (eps_i, Eq. 46) is a weak lever: up to sd=clip=0.5 it changes nothing (the budget
    constraint does not bind at the grand coalition because private yield gains cover the outlay);
    only near 0.8-0.95, when some budgets are almost zero, does it start to matter.  The control
    sweep documents this.

    Outputs (results/ablations/a7_cmp_noise/):
        ccp<C>/raw.csv, summary.csv, meta.json   one standard sweep per carbon price C (the price
                                                 interacts strongly: Shapley only breaks at C >~ 150)
        unstable.csv     one row per (ccp, cmp_noise, panel, mechanism) that is NOT stable:
                         #blocking coalitions and max excess  -> "which panels are unstable"
        blockers.csv     for the largest noise in the grid: the WORST blocking coalition of every
                         unstable (ccp, panel, mechanism): members, area, their mean CMP vs the panel
                         mean, vhat(T), x(T), excess  -> "who blocks and why"
        control_budget_noise/   same panels, budget noise sd=clip varied at fixed cmp_noise, ccp
    Figures (results/figures/): a7_instability_curves.png, a7_instability_panels.png

    The baseline Params are NOT changed; every panel keeps its farm sizes and budget noise because the
    RNG draw order (sizes -> budget noise -> CMP noise) is unchanged, only the CMP noise is rescaled.
